newsitem.title: USA: Pa. approves bill limiting property tax refunds.
newsitem.headline: Pa. approves bill limiting property tax refunds.

text.p: Pennsylvania's General Assembly approved legislation to limit refunds of personal property taxes, hoping to diffuse the threat from a pending lawsuit against the tax.

The lawsuit challenges the constitutionality of the tax, which is applied to stock holdings of out-of-state companies. Pennsylvania counties, many of which stopped collecting the tax in recent years, might have to provide rebates from prior years if the suit is successful.
If the governor signs the bill, however, 18 counties would have to come up with refunds totaling just $60 million, instead of 32 counties now at risk for $231 million in rebates.
